nodes.label: Claude Design Handoff Bundle
nodes.rationale: HTML/CSS/JS prototypes exported for a coding agent: recreate them pixel-perfectly in whatever technology fits the target codebase, matching the visual output rather than copying the prototype's internal structure. Read the chat transcripts first — the final HTML is the output, the chat is where the intent lives — and do not screenshot, since dimensions, colours and layout rules are all in the source.
